title: TASK CLASSES -- the classes of work a route table routes, and who carries each out by default
description: Every token serves the result: what a script or a verb can do deterministically is done by it (zero tokens); a model is spent only where judgement is needed. A class names its default actor; a host's route cells choose the actual one, the model and the effort, and escalate only on a declared signal (ADR-024).
